title: Agent - Add invocationState & plumbing
body:
### Summary

Port over `Agent.invoke({invocationState})` from Python and plumb it through to hooks & toolContext

### Usage

_No response_

### Documentation

https://strandsagents.com/latest/documentation/docs/api-reference/python/agent/agent/#strands.agent.agent.Agent.stream_async

### Reference

https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/blob/main/src/strands/agent/agent.py
